content: The Compact Dark Council Series . SERIES .  Team Beta is the last word in the law of the Supernatural in  boston .  Marcus, Evelyn and Asher make up the team that investigates and dispenses justice for those that break the law. Now something big is happening in the old city, a new coven has sprung up and it is killing humans, worse  then  that, its leaving evidence of there vampire ways, Beta needs to put a stop to this before the compact is destroyed and war  amonsth  the races break out.  Beta Boston’s Special Branch Every town has its guardians, those who enforce the compact among werewolf, vampire, witches, demons and ghosts. In Boston its Marcus, Evelyn and Asher, the vampire, witch and Werewolf who ensure that the compact is not  broken  and humans never know of the existence of the supernatural .  NOTES: These are notes on the book that I can add later as I think of things  A Novel that covers the supernatural world  Vampires, Werewolves, Witches, Warlocks, Demons, Ghosts.  Long ago they agreed to abide by the tenants of the deception.  The  deception allowed  them to live among the humans  The council has groups made up of various  supernatural  usually one Vampire a werewolf and a witch or warlock who police the community.  This is a story of such a group, this group is newly formed and responsible for Massachusetts (Boston, Springfield).  An old vampire comes to Boston and begins to setup a new coven, but his goal is to bring humanity to its knees.
